title: Daniele ti fa il CV
body: A windows only (for now) application to create and manage a curriculum vitae using Electron. The app works by starting a local backend server (written in ASP.NET) on startup which manages an API to generate the PDF file for the CV and to manipulate user data. The data is displayed and can be modified by the user via the UI (written in Angular)

title: Angular Game of Life Background
body: An angular 19+ component that plays Conway's Game of Life while sitting in the background of the page

title: Arch Linux Dotfiles
body: My desktop Hyprland based Arch Linux configuration files. It is meant to be used as a quick setup on a fresh Arch installation to reproduce as much as possible my desktop PC environment. In the repo are documented the packages I consider essential to install for my setup

title: Sabikui
body: A Rust EGUI application designed as an evolution of HashMyFiles by NirSoft. Sabikui is crossplatform and is highly extensible: while HashMyFiles and other similar applications only allow the calculation of a specific set of hash algorithms, Sabikui searches its configuration folder for executables, each one of them a cli application that should get a list of files to hash and should give as output a list of hash values using a specific hash algorithm.

title: CHIP-8 Interpreter
body: A TUI CHIP-8 interpreter written in Rust using Ratatui. It supports every original CHIP-8 instruction (so features specific for other CHIP-8 variants are not garanteed to be supported). The repo contains various ROM gathered from the web for a quick try. It also supports step by step execution and pausing. Should also be crossplatform
